children: it has opened a new office at 122 Fifth Avenue, New York, as the fintech enters its next phase of growth.
The 84K-sq.-ft. office spans three floors and brings together New York-based employees across product, engineering, enterprise, marketing, partnerships, and other teams.

"As the leading consumer financial technology brand, it is only natural that Chime would have a flagship office in the financial capital of the world. New York is already our largest metropolitan market," said CEO Chris Britt.

title: Chime Financial opens new office in New York
